Draw one icon in pure white flat ink (#FFFFFF) on a fully transparent background, in exactly the style of the attached reference icons: Wick, the small figure of the trait and perk icons with the ceramic pixel-screen head, capelet and lantern heart, in bold flat white shapes, a confident inked silhouette with a few interior cuts, the same line weight. It must read at 32 px in a row and at 44 px on a chip: silhouette first, two or three interior cuts at most. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame.
